Bacteria samples from Sydney swim sites, with recent rainfall

Source: R/data.R
beach_samples.Rd

Water samples collected by Beachwatch NSW at 77 swim sites across Sydney between January 2015 and April 2025. Each sample is matched to the rainfall recorded in the 72 hours (three calendar days) before the sample date.

Usage

beach_samples

Format

A tibble with 36,062 rows and 9 columns:

region

Beachwatch region: Northern Sydney, Southern Sydney, Sydney City, Sydney Harbour or Western Sydney.

council

Local council responsible for the site.

swim_site

Name of the beach, baths or swim site.

date

Date the sample was taken.

enterococci

Enterococci bacteria count, in colony-forming units (cfu) per 100 mL of water. Higher counts indicate more faecal contamination and a higher risk of illness from swimming.

water_temp_c

Water temperature (degrees Celsius); may be NA.

rain_72h_mm

Total rainfall (mm) on the three days before the sample date, from sydney_rainfall.

latitude, longitude

Location of the swim site.

Source

Beachwatch NSW, NSW Government, https://www.beachwatch.nsw.gov.au/waterMonitoring/waterQualityData, as curated for TidyTuesday (2025-05-20) by Jen Richmond, https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2025/2025-05-20.

Details

Samples without an enterococci result and exact duplicate records were removed. Rainfall comes from a single modelled location near Sydney Observatory Hill, so it will not capture local storms at every beach. The preparation script is data-raw/beach_samples.R in the package source.
